location_note: Lower northern slope of Nebi Samwil, south bank of Wadi 'Amir, c. 700 m south of el-Jib; map ref. 217605/638501 (NIG).
notes: 2007 ADCA salvage excavation of six units: winepress (1), four caves (2-5) and an underground quarry (6) of unknown date. Cave 3, a natural cave enlarged for a Late Bronze Age I burial (four individuals), later used to the Ottoman period (Hellenistic, Early Roman sherds). Caves 2, 4, 5 are called residential caves; no dates given.

features.subtype: natural cave expanded for burial; primary and secondary interments with LB pottery
features.period: Late Bronze Age I (burial); later non-burial use to the Ottoman period
features.quote: Cave 3 is a natural formation that was expanded for use

features.subtype: caves hewn in a limestone outcrop, called residential caves, with artifacts of various periods
features.quote: a series of caves hewn into a limestone outcrop were unearthed

features.period: quarry 'from an unknown period'; winepress not dated
